mapper.select: SELECT sm.sys_menu_perm FROM sys_menu sm LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu srm ON sm.sys_menu_id = srm.sys_menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.sys_role_id = srm.sys_role_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur ON sur.sys_role_id = sr.sys_role_id WHERE sm.sys_menu_type = 'BUTTON' AND sur.sys_user_id = #{userId}
SELECT su.*, sug.copms_list FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN sys_user_grid sug ON sug.user_id = su.user_id WHERE su.username = #{accessKey}
